name: Clear Solutions (Founders Pledge)
summary: Community health workers bringing oral rehydration salts and zinc to children with diarrhoea in Nigeria. Founders Pledge's page states the drugs cost less than $0.60 a course; our bridge scales GiveWell's ORS/zinc analysis to that price.

sections.title: Founders Pledge's figure
sections.explainer: Founders Pledge's own figures, as its recommendation page states them. It publishes no spreadsheet for this recommendation, so these are the model's only evaluator rows.

sections.title: From the price of a course to units of value
sections.explainer: charityevals' bridge, not Founders Pledge's: the page's figure is the price of the drugs for one course, not the program's full cost or its effect. We take GiveWell's ORS/zinc analysis of the same program and scale it by GiveWell's price for the same co-pack over Founders Pledge's.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Founders Pledge's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's pay below what they could earn elsewhere counts as an in-kind contribution and gets its share of the outcome. Off by default.

rows.explainer: The part of GiveWell's value that moves with our value-of-life lever.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.formula: if($resource_shares, gw_uov_all_support, gw_uov_philanthropic) * (gw_mortality_share * $life_value_multiplier + 1 - gw_mortality_share) * gw_copack_price / cost_per_course
rows.explainer: GiveWell's value per dollar, scaled by GiveWell's price for the same co-pack over Founders Pledge's (about 0.64 against 0.60, ×1.06). GiveWell builds every cost from the drug price (non-commodity costs ×2.25, leakage ×1.1, a matching government share), so before its leverage step a cheaper course stretches every dollar in proportion; after it the scaling is approximate, and GiveWell's course adds an extra ORS sachet the co-pack price leaves out. Founders Pledge's price is no evidence that Clear Solutions' course is cheaper; the result is close to GiveWell's own.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Units of value per donor dollar
rows.explainer: Units of value per dollar, in GiveWell's units (one unit = a year of doubled income for one person). With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
